policy: Manually reviewed aggregate asking-price observations for import planning. Listings, seller text, contacts, and photos are not republished. These are not completed sales, export quotes, or live inventory.

observations.sampleVariant: 2018 Toyota Camry petrol 2.5L, mixed LE/SE/GLE and GCC/US specifications
observations.fxSourceName: Central Bank of the UAE exchange rates, 25 September 2026
observations.method: Retained eight visible 2018 petrol 2.5L asking prices: AED 32,000, 33,000, 36,000, 38,500, 40,000, 45,000, 45,000, and 49,500. Excluded hybrid, unspecified engines, and one car disclosing damage. Interpolated quartiles, converted at 3.6725 AED per USD, and rounded the USD band to the nearest $100.
observations.limitations: The source page stated a 16 September 2026 update. Mileage spans about 57,000–250,000 km and specifications differ. Listing availability, seller independence, export suitability, freight, customs valuation, duty, clearing, and registration are not verified or included in the source asking band. Obtain a current seller quote and inspect before importing.
